description: Schemas bundled with fair-bioheaders-java, by FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification release (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md). 'current' are the copies of the specification main that raw-main URLs select; the release named there is the one they belong to. Each release entry points at a frozen copy of that release's schema. Only released contracts appear here: FHT and FHGM have no released schema, no w3id alias and no entry in the shared schemas/versions.json registry, and this reader implements no draft lane (rule V7 opt-in is not supported; see docs/STATUS.md).
